title: Gas Furnace vs Heat Pump
channel: Monkey Wrench Plumbing, Heating, Air & Electric
summary: Los Angeles HVAC company compares air-source heat pumps and gas furnaces on function, efficiency, cost, emissions and cold performance, favouring heat pumps in mild climates.

assertions.quote: there's no need to install a separate cooling system like an air conditioner
anything below 40° will cause the heat pump's efficiency to slip
your choice between them depends on your local gas and electricity rates
you can expect a higher upfront invest cost with heat pumps
require less upkeep since they do not burn fossil fuels

verdicts.note: Heat pumps run year-round and have refrigerant circuits while furnaces have combustion parts; there is little independent data comparing repair rates.

assertions.quote: air source heat pumps produce fewer carbon emissions
a heat pump system particularly an air source heat pump is often a better fit due to the mild climate

verdicts.note: In mild climates heat pumps run at high COP, need no backup and replace the AC, so they usually beat a furnace plus AC.
